description: What the main window may do. Deliberately almost nothing: the host, key and pilot commands are messages to a process this crate already started, and the one plugin capability granted here is `dialog:allow-open` - a directory chooser the OS draws and a person drives, which returns a path and launches nothing. Every other dialog permission (`save`, `message`, `ask`, `confirm`) arrives with `dialog:default` and is deliberately not taken, because none of them has a caller.
